discussion_comments.comment_body: can be more restful and just get rid of create
what's this used for? I don't think we'll need/want to return this here, but only in the control plane will we load the relevant api keys
This was supposed to return back the api key mapped to the router so that the user can copy it but now that we're doing the /router-id way im gonna think over this workflow a bit and get back

on my first read of it, it did feel weird that we were still auto creating a key, but then i thought about it and ATM i feel like it's nice for the user that it saves some clicks, since anytime you create a gateway, you will need to create an associated key no matter what, so might as well do it for them to improve UX? I cant think of a counterpoint atm.


though, i think we should remove the field from this type, since we should only return this key once upon creation (ie the `createRouterConfig` method), and not anymore after that. in `createRouterConfig` we're using an inline declared type so we dont need the field on the `LatestRouterConfig` type
ohhh i think i mixed up the types somewhere here when i was cleaning up the code my bad... i did mean for it to only be returned on create which it still is but the type suggests otherwise - fixing
